description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) for notes in a note-taking application. It includes representations for note summaries, detailed note views, and request payloads for creating and updating notes. The classes use data annotations for validation purposes.

classes.name: NoteSummaryDto
classes.description: A compact representation of a note used in list responses, containing ID, title, last updated time, and optional color.

classes.name: NoteDetailDto
classes.description: A detailed representation of a note, including ID, title, content, color, creation, and last update timestamps.

classes.name: CreateNoteRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a new note, requiring title and content, with optional color.

classes.name: UpdateNoteRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating an existing note, requiring title and content, with optional color.
